lines.item: Hotel - Fairfield Inn & Suites Manhattan/Central Park, King Room, 7 nights
lines.note: Booking.com prints $985.60 as "Total before taxes" and lists 14.75% tax plus $4 city tax per night as excluded. $985.60 x 1.1475 + $28 = $1,158.98 (derived, not a quote).

lines.item: Flights - 2 adults, AMS to JFK return, 15-22 Feb 2027 (the itinerary's own dates)
lines.note: Out on 15 Feb, back on 22 Feb: Aer Lingus 1-stop round trip $606 per adult, nonstop KLM/Delta $904-906, and the absolute cheapest $562 with a 6h20m Dublin layover. The line uses the $606 itinerary x 2. Google Flights prices 1 adult, so two seats may not cost exactly double (F-15).

lines.item: Transit - 2 adults, 7 days, MTA fare cap
lines.note: MTA caps subway and local bus spend at $35 per person per 7-day period with tap-and-ride. 2 x $35 is the maximum, not an estimate.

lines.item: American Museum of Natural History - 2 adults, standard general admission
lines.note: Official page: standard adult general admission $37 for visitors from outside NY State; $37 x 2 = $74. NY State residents pay what they wish.

lines.item: 9/11 Memorial & Museum - 2 adults (top of the official range)
Top of the Rock - 2 adults (official 'from' price)
Dinner at Le Bernardin - Chef's Tasting for 2, food only
lines.note: $350 per person. With the wine pairing ($530 pp) the same meal is $1,060 for two.

lines.item: Dinner at Gabriel Kreuther - Chef's Tasting for 2, food only
lines.note: $325 per person. Wine pairing from $255 pp is extra.

lines.item: Breakfast, lunches and non-MICHELIN dinners - 7 days, 2 adults
lines.note: No official source exists for what a couple spends on ordinary meals. Inventing a daily allowance would be a guess, so this line is blank.

budget.verified_subtotal_note: Sum of the eleven priced lines. Hotel is a derived all-in figure, flights are a doubled single-adult fare; the other lines are read amounts. Ordinary meals are blank.

days.plan: Land at JFK, check in. Evening walk to Times Square / Rockefeller Center. No timed booking on arrival day.
MoMA in the morning (opens 10:30). Top of the Rock timed entry late afternoon for daylight and dusk.
The Met on the Upper East Side, then Central Park on foot.
9/11 Memorial & Museum (open Wed-Mon, so Thursday works), then the Statue of Liberty ferry option.
High Line and Chelsea Market by day. Le Bernardin Chef's Tasting at 17:00 or later.
Brooklyn Bridge walkway early, then DUMBO. Gabriel Kreuther for dinner in Midtown.
Weather-dependent day or a second museum. Le Bernardin is closed Sunday, so no starred dinner is booked.

itineraries.title: 4 nights - the literal preferred window (15-18 Feb 2027)

days.plan: Arrive, settle in, evening in Midtown.
9/11 Memorial & Museum, Brooklyn Bridge walk at sunset.
Le Bernardin or Gabriel Kreuther as the single splurge, then depart.

itineraries.note: Fits the preferred dates exactly but allows only one MICHELIN dinner and no buffer day.

itineraries.title: 14 nights - upper end of the brief (15 Feb - 1 Mar 2027)

days.plan: Outer-borough stars (Aska and Francie in Brooklyn, Meju in Queens), a day trip, a second starred dinner. The second week's hotel cost was NOT priced (Q-13).

itineraries.note: Two weeks doubles the hotel line. The second week's real price must be captured before this can be budgeted.

flags.title: The MICHELIN New York list changes on 14 December 2026 - before the trip
flags.detail: The next New York star ceremony is scheduled for Monday 14 December 2026. Every star shown on this site is the list published at the 18 November 2025 ceremony. Between now and February 2027 the entire roster can change.
flags.settle_by: Re-read https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/article/michelin-guide-ceremony after 2026-12-14 and re-run the star tables

flags.title: MICHELIN's own two official sources disagree on the star count
flags.detail: The ceremony article lists 72 star entries (5 three-star / 15 two-star / 52 one-star). MICHELIN's own filtered list pages, read the same day, show 69 (5 / 14 / 50). The site publishes the 72-entry roster because it is the authoritative ceremony publication, and shows the 69 figure next to it rather than silently picking one.
flags.settle_by: Compare the two lists name by name and record which 3 are missing

flags.title: Hotel prices are a live snapshot, and every one carries a time-limited promotion
flags.detail: All hotel totals were read on 2026-11-25 and several rely on a 'Black Friday Deal' the booking page says is valid for select stays between 19 Nov 2026 and 31 Dec 2027. The undiscounted list prices are shown alongside so the real rate is visible. Any price here can change before booking.
flags.settle_by: Re-check the same URL the day of booking

flags.title: All seven hotel totals exclude tax; the per-night city tax is not uniform
flags.detail: Every Booking.com room row used here prints "Total before taxes" and lists 14.75% tax as excluded. The city tax is $4/night at most properties but $6/night at Residence Inn FiDi. Arlo SoHo and Arlo Midtown also exclude a $1/night tourism fee. The site derives an all-in column per hotel from the fees printed on that hotel's own row.
flags.settle_by: Read the 'Excluded' line on each room row (done) and apply tax where excluded

flags.title: The one-hour MICHELIN rule is modelled, not measured
flags.detail: Travel times on this site are computed from straight-line distance at an assumed average speed, then labelled MODEL. Only a handful of legs were checked against a real transit router. A model can be wrong in either direction, especially across the East River where there is no direct subway.
flags.settle_by: Run each hotel-to-restaurant pair through an MTA-scheduled journey planner for a weekday 19:00 departure

flags.title: Most restaurant menu prices could not be read
flags.detail: Four venues now publish a readable standard price: Le Bernardin ($350), Gabriel Kreuther ($325), Per Se ($200 deposit, not the full menu price) and Gramercy Tavern ($178 seasonal Dining Room menu). Eleven Madison Park, Jungsik, Sushi Sho and Daniel still publish no readable price. Prices were read from the official menu or booking pages linked in each row.
flags.settle_by: Open each remaining venue's Resy/Tock page, where the tasting-menu price is displayed before payment

flags.title: TikTok could not be verified at all
flags.detail: Every TikTok URL returned HTTP 400 to an automated read on 2026-11-25. No TikTok handle is asserted anywhere on this site; where TikTok appears it is a search link, labelled as a search.
flags.settle_by: Open the venue's own website and look for a TikTok icon, or search TikTok manually

flags.title: One Instagram handle was inferred, not opened
flags.detail: The Chelsea Market handle @chelseamarketny was read in a post by the verified High Line account, not by opening the Chelsea Market profile itself. It is labelled as unconfirmed.
flags.settle_by: Open https://www.instagram.com/chelseamarketny/ directly

flags.title: The High Line is verified; The Met's hours come from an official page excerpt only
flags.detail: The High Line's official visitor page states December–March 07:00–20:00. The Met's own page excerpt lists Sun–Tue and Thu 10:00–17:00, Fri–Sat 10:00–21:00, closed Wednesday, but a direct fetch of that page redirected to the generic visit page. The Met row is therefore PARTIAL, not VERIFIED.
flags.settle_by: Open the Met Fifth Avenue page in a browser that renders its hours block

flags.title: Restaurant hours conflict between MICHELIN and the restaurant
flags.detail: Gramercy Tavern's MICHELIN listing shows dinner ending at 21:00, while the restaurant's own Instagram says the Tavern is open until 23:00 seven days a week. Both are official; they describe different rooms. The row is flagged rather than resolved.
flags.settle_by: Check gramercytavern.com hours for each room separately

flags.title: Presidents' Day is confirmed by an official 2027 holiday list
flags.detail: OPM's 2027 federal holiday table lists Monday 15 February as Washington's Birthday. The colloquial name Presidents' Day is not used by OPM.
flags.settle_by: Done - OPM 2027 table read 2026-11-26

flags.title: The second week of a 14-night trip is unpriced
flags.detail: Only the 15–22 Feb window was priced per hotel. The same Fairfield king room is $996.10 before tax on 16–23 Feb and $1,020.60 before tax on 22 Feb – 1 Mar, i.e. $1,171.02 and $1,199.14 derived all-in. The second week of a 14-night stay therefore has a known rate for this one hotel, but not for the other six.
flags.settle_by: Price 22 Feb – 1 Mar for the other six hotels

flags.title: Street addresses for all seven hotels were read from Booking.com property pages
flags.detail: Addresses were read on 2026-11-26 from each hotel's own Booking.com page and are now shown in the table. Coordinates used by the travel model remain area-level approximations and have not been recalculated from these addresses.
flags.settle_by: Re-run the reach model from street addresses if the one-hour rule becomes decisive

flags.title: Accessible room types were the cheapest qualifying rooms at two hotels
flags.detail: At Hyatt Place Chelsea the cheapest king room on these dates was the roll-in-shower accessible room, and at citizenM Bowery the accessible king. Those rooms are bookable by anyone, but a standard room may price differently.
flags.settle_by: Compare the standard king rate on the same dates

flags.title: The flight price is a fare, not a booking
flags.detail: The AMS-JFK fares quoted ($543-$686 one adult, round trip) were read on aggregator pages. Fares change hourly and the cheapest itineraries have long layovers or are basic tickets without checked bags.
flags.settle_by: Price the same dates for 2 adults on the airline's own site

flags.title: One venue's hours exist in MICHELIN's data but not as text
flags.detail: Le Bernardin's Friday closing time is 23:00 and Saturday opens at 17:00; both were read from the structured hours block. Jungsik has no hours block at all on its MICHELIN page.
flags.settle_by: Read jungsik.com reservations page

flags.title: All seven advertised hotel totals exclude tax; ranking must use the derived all-in column
flags.detail: The 25 Nov snapshot used a figure of $1,155.48 for Fairfield and labelled it tax-inclusive. Re-reading the dated Booking.com page on 26 Nov 2026 shows "Total before taxes $985.60" and "Excluded: 14.75 % TAX, $4 City tax per night". The $1,155.48 figure is therefore withdrawn. On the corrected all-in basis Fairfield is still cheapest at $1,158.98, ahead of Arlo SoHo at $1,206.60.
flags.settle_by: Confirm the final charge at checkout

flags.title: A 'star cluster' cannot be demonstrated from this dataset
flags.detail: Coordinates were verified for only 7 of the 72 star entries. Among those 7, only Eleven Madison Park and Gramercy Tavern sit within a kilometre of another scored venue (353 m). The others are each more than 1 km from the next one, so Manhattan star dining is dispersed rather than clustered. Any neighbourhood-level cluster map would be invented.
flags.settle_by: Verify coordinates for all 72 entries and compute density

flags.title: The hotel reach ranking covers 7 restaurants, not 72
flags.detail: The brief asks hotels to be ranked by how many MICHELIN restaurants are reachable within an hour. Only the 7 venues with verified coordinates can be scored, so the ranking is out of 7 rather than out of 72. The five Midtown and Chelsea hotels are effectively tied on it, which is why cost decides the recommendation.
flags.settle_by: Verify all 72 coordinates and run a measured journey matrix

flags.title: Activity travel times are modelled, and the Statue of Liberty only just qualifies
flags.detail: All eleven activities fall inside the modelled one-hour reach of the recommended hotel, but the Statue of Liberty does so at 56 modelled minutes to Battery Park, before the roughly 15-minute ferry to the island. It is the one activity where the rule is satisfied by a margin thin enough that a real schedule could break it.
flags.settle_by: Query a scheduled journey planner for the hotel-to-Battery-Park leg at 09:00 on a weekday

flags.title: Three prices came from a Booking.com results table; all seven now have direct property-page links
flags.detail: Direct hotel pages were found and read for Arlo SoHo, Hyatt Place Chelsea and Residence Inn FiDi on 26 Nov 2026, so every row now links to its own property page. Their room rates on those pages differ from the 25 Nov search snapshot (Arlo SoHo especially), so both reads are published rather than silently replacing one with the other.
flags.settle_by: Choose which snapshot to use for booking (new question Q-27)

flags.title: Hotel rates moved between the 25 and 26 November 2026 reads
flags.detail: A second read of the dated Booking.com property pages on 26 Nov 2026 found different cheapest qualifying rates at citizenM Times Square ($1,113 vs $1,147), Arlo SoHo ($1,087 vs $1,021), Arlo Midtown ($1,171 vs $1,136.68) and Pestana CR7 ($1,175 vs $1,276). Both snapshots are published; the ranking uses the 25 Nov snapshot consistently and must be re-run before booking.
flags.settle_by: Re-read all seven property pages on the booking day and rebuild the ranking

flags.title: The $1,155.48 Fairfield figure published on 25 November was not supportable by its source
flags.detail: The source page prints "Total before taxes $985.60" and lists the taxes as excluded. The withdrawn figure was used for the hotel total, the executive summary and the budget. All have been corrected to $985.60 advertised and $1,158.98 derived all-in; the budget subtotal moved from $4,107.48 to $4,110.98.
flags.settle_by: Done - corrected 2026-11-26

suggestions.title: Make this dashboard the single canonical site and retire the duplicate dataset
suggestions.problem: Two independently researched datasets are published side by side and disagree on the star count (72 vs 69), the hotel shortlist and the transit method. A reader cannot tell which to trust.
suggestions.proposal: Keep this dashboard as the canonical dataset, move the older deep dive to an 'archive' page with a one-line explanation, and delete the cross-links that present them as equal.
suggestions.risk: Low - nothing is deleted that is not first archived

suggestions.title: Replace modelled travel times with measured ones
suggestions.problem: The one-hour rule is the brief's central constraint and it is currently a straight-line model.
suggestions.proposal: Batch-query an MTA-scheduled journey planner for all 7 hotels x the star restaurants that matter, cache the JSON, and show the measured door-to-door minutes with the query time and date. Keep the model only as a fallback, clearly labelled.

suggestions.title: Add a price-watch column with a re-check date
suggestions.problem: Every price on the site is a 2026-11-25 snapshot, and the booking pages say promotions expire.
suggestions.proposal: Add 'price checked on' and 're-check by' columns, and a single page listing every external URL with the date it was last read, so re-verification is a checklist rather than a memory exercise.

suggestions.title: Finish the menu-price matrix from booking platforms
suggestions.problem: Four of the eight priority restaurants have no price, which makes the dinner plan impossible to budget fully.
suggestions.proposal: Read the booking-platform price pages for EMP, Jungsik, Sushi Sho and Daniel; keep Gramercy Tavern's official $178 menu and the other published prices as they are.

suggestions.title: Give every table a mobile card view, not just a scrolling table
suggestions.problem: Seven-column tables on a 390px phone require horizontal scrolling, which is where readers give up.
suggestions.proposal: Below 640px, render each row as a stacked card with the name, star level, hours and links visible without scrolling; keep the true table for desktop.

suggestions.title: Add a printable one-page trip card
suggestions.problem: The site is a research document; on the day you need one page with addresses, hours and confirmation numbers.
suggestions.proposal: A print stylesheet plus a single page containing only confirmed bookings, with blank fields for confirmation numbers that the traveller fills in.

suggestions.title: Automate the link and data-integrity check
suggestions.problem: Manual checking does not scale past a few dozen rows and silently rots.
suggestions.proposal: A script run on every commit that (a) checks every internal link resolves, (b) checks every external URL returns 200, (c) fails the build if a table row has no source, and (d) fails if any numeric cell is non-numeric.
suggestions.risk: Low - external checks can be flaky, so warn rather than fail on those

suggestions.title: Separate 'starred' from 'guide-listed' into two visually distinct badges
suggestions.problem: A reader can mistake a Bib Gourmand or a plain listing for a star.
suggestions.proposal: Use one badge per distinction - three-star, two-star, one-star, Green Star, Bib Gourmand, Selected - with the badge drawn from MICHELIN's own icons and a legend at the top of the table.

suggestions.title: Show the all-in hotel cost, not the advertised rate
suggestions.problem: Some rows include tax and some do not, so the cheapest-looking row is not always the cheapest.
suggestions.proposal: Compute and display one 'total for 7 nights, taxes and fees included' figure per hotel in a single sortable column, and keep the advertised rate visible only as a secondary detail.
suggestions.risk: Medium - the tax treatment differs by property and must be read per room, not assumed

suggestions.title: Add a February-specific weather and packing section
suggestions.problem: February in New York is cold and the itinerary includes outdoor walks; nothing on the site warns about it.
suggestions.proposal: Add a small panel with historical February temperature ranges from an official climate source and a packing list tied to the outdoor activities actually planned.

suggestions.title: Replace social search links with verified posts wherever an account is confirmed
suggestions.problem: Most social cells are search links, which is honest but not what the brief asked for.
suggestions.proposal: Where an official account is verified, link two or three specific posts (the profile page exposes recent post URLs) instead of the profile. Where no account exists, keep the labelled search link.
suggestions.risk: Low - post URLs can be deleted by the venue

suggestions.title: Add a booking countdown and deadline tracker
suggestions.problem: Eighty percent of the starred restaurants take reservations about 30 days ahead, and the hotel's free-cancellation deadline is 12 February 2027.
suggestions.proposal: A dated checklist of the actions in the order they must happen, each with the exact deadline (open booking date, free-cancel date, ticket release date).
suggestions.risk: None - the 30-day rule is a common pattern, so verify each venue's own window before relying on it
